'''Daniil Captane''' was the [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]] on [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] when [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] defeated the [[Norulac Freebooters]]. Captane felt that Calrissian was being modest when he downplayed his achievement in the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]].<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
